earlier_findings_fixed: Door leaves, 0.10 m terrace deck and 4 cm door sills were visual-only geometry the LiDAR saw as obstacles or people: removed from the mesh
SLAM had missed part of the west wall: the planner routed through it once the terrace was free; the wall is now drawn from the collision model
Sharp turns inside the doorway stalled the controller: trips now go square through a door via staging poses
A person standing in a doorway flickered as a track and the plan flipped between doors: standing tracks persist 3 s; a door check (planned path length) decides before driving through
